decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed use of the caretaker's house independent of the Feltham Leisure Centre, would because of its position, siting, enhancement of the site and access would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 51A Uxbridge Road, Feltham and would not be detrimental to the character and appearance of the Feltham Leisure Centre, the Metropolitan Green Belt, the amenities of the adjacent neighbouring properties, the street scene and the area generally.  On balance, the development is in accordance with the Adopted UDP Policies IMP 1.2(The Re-use and Recycling of Urban Land),ENV- B.1.1 (New Development) H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development.), H.3.1(Presumption Against Loss of Residential),H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guideline), H.6.1(Housing Improvements) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan Adopted (December 2003) and the Supplementary Planning Guidelines. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.
description: The use of the caretaker's house independent of the Feltham Leisure Centre
